(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LV OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Punjab
Civil Courts
Ordinance, 1962,
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 26th September, 2002]
No. Legis.13-3/89, dated
26-9-2002.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.-------(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab Civil
Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
